newsitem.title: GERMANY: EMI discussed monetary operations-BOE's George.
newsitem.headline: EMI discussed monetary operations-BOE's George.

text.p: Bank of England governor Eddie George said on Tuesday that the day's regular European Monetary Institute (EMI) council meeting had mainly discussed issues relating to the operations of monetary policy.
"It was rather a long meeting. We discussed all those usual details of operation (of monetary policy)," George told Reuters, declining to give more specific details.
George also said there was a long discussion at the meeting on the design of the banknote for the planned Euro currency.
He declined comment on broader issues such as the stability pact for monetary union, saying such things were a matter for finance ministers.
Tuesday's EMI council meeting ran from around 0900 GMT to around 1700 GMT, somewhat longer than usual.
The EMI council comprises 15 central bank governors and EMI president Alexandre Lamfalussy.
